questions.question: Which of the following gods is known as the king of the gods in Greek mythology?
questions.explanation: Zeus is the supreme god in the Greek pantheon and rules over the sky. He is known for his power and authority and plays a central role in many mythological narratives of antiquity.

choices: Which food is rich in proteins?

questions.question: Chicken eggs are an excellent source of protein and contain all essential amino acids. They are commonly used in diets and are particularly popular among athletes.
choices: Which river forms the border between the United States and Mexico?

questions.question: The Rio Grande flows from the Rocky Mountains to the Gulf of Mexico and forms a section of the border between the United States and Mexico. It is a significant river both geographically and historically for the region.
choices: Which ruler is often considered the first emperor of the Holy Roman Empire?

questions.question: Charlemagne, also known as Charles the Great, was crowned emperor in the year 800. He played a crucial role in the formation of the Carolingian Empire and contributed to the spread of Christianity in Europe.
choices: Which author is considered one of the most important representatives of European realism and wrote the work 'Madame Bovary'?

questions.question: 'Madame Bovary' by Gustave Flaubert is considered a key work of realism. Flaubert vividly describes the life reality of his protagonist and criticizes the society of that time.
choices: Which weather condition is typically represented by a symbol with a sun ray and a cloud?

questions.question: The symbol with a sun ray and a cloud indicates that the sun is shining partially while there are also clouds present. This suggests a weather condition with changing cloud cover without precipitation.
choices: Who is the current President of the United States?

questions.question: A: Joe Biden
choices: Which international association is responsible for regulations in rugby?

World Rugby is the international governing body for rugby and is responsible for the regulation and organization of the sport on a global level. FIFA is responsible for soccer, FIBA for basketball, and IAAF for athletics.

questions.question: A: World Rugby
choices: Which English word is derived from Turkish, reflecting cultural exchange in recent migrations?

The word 'kebab' comes from Turkish, demonstrating the influence of Turkish cuisine on English vocabulary. This reflects the cultural interactions that have occurred through migration and globalization.

questions.question: A: Kebab
choices: Which website is known for sharing videos?

YouTube is a platform that allows users to upload, view, and share videos. In contrast, Wikipedia is an encyclopedia, Amazon is an online store, and LinkedIn is a professional network. These mix-ups are common due to the variety of platforms available.

questions.question: A: YouTube
choices: In which year did the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT) come into effect, representing a significant step towards free trade?

questions.question: B: 1978
choices: Which of the following statements best describes the term 'catalyst' in chemistry?
A catalyst increases the reaction rate by lowering the activation energy requirement but remains unchanged after the reaction. This means it is not consumed and can be reused in further reactions.
A: A catalyst changes the products of a chemical reaction.

questions.question: B: A catalyst is always a metal.
choices: D: A catalyst accelerates a chemical reaction without being consumed.
B: Ein Katalysator ist immer ein Metall.
C: Ein Katalysator ist ein Stoff, der in einer chemischen Reaktion stets verbraucht wird.
D: Ein Katalysator beschleunigt eine chemische Reaktion, ohne selbst verbraucht zu werden.
questions.explanation: C: A catalyst is a substance that is always consumed in a chemical reaction.
